items.name: Just Cube and Go Pangasinan 2026
items.information:
You don't have to do other things, Just Cube and Go!

# **IMPORTANT REMINDER**
Although this is a free competition, you still need to secure your slot by paying a "securing fee" which costs Php 300.00. To refund the payment, you MUST attend the competition. Just approach Kuya Xavier, the organizer, for the refund. Failing to attend the competition may open slots for walk-ins.
​
![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6NDg4OTMsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--dd8f31a5987d34a734158346c72c137e514bc738/Just%20Cube%20and%20GO.png)

items.name: Penang Niche Dual 2026

venue.name: ITPA Penang
venue.address: The Promenade, 5-5-37, Persiaran Mahsuri, Bandar Bayan Lepas, 11900 Bayan Lepas, Pulau Pinang

items.information:
## Note: This competition does not feature the 3x3x3 Cube event.
Welcome to Penang Niche DUAL 2026! This competition only features 3x3x3 One-Handed, Skewb, Clock and Square-1.

[![Malaysia Cube Sports Association(MYCSA)](https://i.imgur.com/ZUv6wZJm.png)](https://www.mycubeassociation.org/competition/info/PenangNicheDual2026)

If you are a new competitor, please make sure to read all the information in the Updates & Announcements and the New Competitors tabs before registering. All competitors should be familiar with the information in these tabs.

Competitors should ensure that their email address registered with the WCA is valid and up-to-date, as organizers will use it to send important competition updates and pre-competition information.

*Our schedule, cutoff & time limit is subject to change based on the number of registrants for each event; please pay close attention throughout the open registration period to see if our schedule has been adjusted.*

items.name: Veni Vidi Vellmar 2026
items.information:
Wir laden euch ein zu zwei Tagen Cubing in Vellmar samt Aftercomp mit gemeinsamen Essen, Brettspielen, Dart, Kreuzworträtseln und worauf ihr noch lust habt.

We invite you to two days of cubing in Vellmar paired with some aftercomp activities like dinner, boardgames, darts, cross-word puzzle and anything else you would like to do.
